name: structure
description: Structural-element plot items. Each element type has its own 'plot item create <type>' command. Type names and keywords are binary-validated against FLAC2D 9.0.

sub_items.name: contour
sub_items.description: Continuous coloring of beam-family structural elements by force / moment / displacement / velocity / link-* attributes.

notes: Element type names REQUIRE the 'structure-' prefix in FLAC2D 9.0. Bare names like 'beam', 'cable', 'liner', 'pile', 'shell', 'geogrid', 'structure-node' are NOT accepted.
'shell' and 'geogrid' have no dedicated plot item type in FLAC2D 9.0; use 'structure-liner' or check the FLAC3D vocabulary.
For node-level fix markers, use 'plot item create struct-node-fix'.
Beam-family element types (beam, cable, liner, pile) share the same top-level keyword set, but their 'contour' attribute lists differ — probe 'plot item create structure-<type> contour ?' for each.

FLAC3D 9.7 adds structure-shell, structure-geogrid, structure-dowel and structure-hybrid item types (see available_types_flac3d_97). The beam family uses line-style keywords including CamelCase Bar/BarScale/FlipBars ('Bar' takes a boolean; leaked internal property names, but real accepted keywords); the shell family (structure-shell verified) uses surface-style keywords (polygons) and has no Bar/line keywords. Verified against FLAC3D 9.7 via '?' probing (2026-08-13). Full 3D keyword sets: see flac3d-items.json.
struct-node-fix (FLAC3D 9.7) adds a 'rotational' keyword over the gridpoint-fix marker set.
Beam-family top-level keywords (13): active, color-list, contour, deformation-factor, label, legend, line, map, marker, range, shrink, slot, system
structure-vector top-level keywords (13): active, by-magnitude, color, deformation-factor, draw-as, legend, map, point-to-base, range, scale, shape, structures, value

keywords.description: Vector field at structural-element nodes (displacement, velocity, force-applied, reaction, etc.).
keywords.name: structure-vector

examples.command: plot item create structure-beam contour moment legend active on
examples.description: Continuous moment color map along beams. Use case: Beams colored by bending moment

examples.command: plot item create structure-cable contour force-axial legend active on
examples.description: Highlight cable axial loading. Use case: Cables colored by axial force

examples.command: plot item create structure-vector value displacement
examples.description: Vector arrows at structural-element nodes. Use case: Structural-element displacement vectors

examples.command: plot item create structure-liner label group legend active on
examples.description: Different color per liner group. Use case: Liners colored by group

verification: available types flac3d 97 (9): structure-beam, structure-cable, structure-dowel, structure-geogrid, structure-hybrid, structure-liner, structure-pile, structure-shell, structure-vector
